title: Patterned Masks and Black Figures
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 21 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Patterned masks, and then black figures. This room holds two things that look nothing alike and were drawn in the same two weeks of November 2022. First the masks: faces packed with pattern, hearts, hatching, spirals, crowns, drawn over paint until the square is full. Then the figures: flat black shapes on a bright ground, a girl in a dress, a creature on all fours, a man in the rain.

The two earliest works in the room are the two earliest in the whole series, from May 2022, and they are masks too, packed to the frame. The masks that follow in November turn into skulls and sun-faces, and then on November 10 the black figures arrive, three in one evening.
Watch the black. In the masks it is one color among many. In the figures it is the whole body, and everything else, the maze, the sun, the rain, is drawn around it.

chapters.title: Two from May
chapters.opening: May 8 and 9, 2022. The first two Rawblocks works, drawn six months before the rest: two dense masks inside white frames.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #1
works.text: A mask packed with pattern inside a white frame: a ringed eye in a box at the left, a spiral eye in a box at the right, a mouth of white bars, and around them columns of beads, zigzags and hatching in red, yellow, blue and green. Nothing is empty. The first Rawblocks work, drawn May 8, 2022, with 387 recorded strokes, the most in the room.
works.caption: A mask packed with pattern inside a white frame, a ringed eye and a spiral eye in boxes.
works.reading: The beads run in columns at the left and right edges, drawn as small circles with dark centers. The mouth is a box of white bars with black between. The ground behind the pattern is teal and olive. Pink capsules sit at the lower right.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #2
works.text: A second mask in a white frame, the next day, with a red target eye in a box, a gold eye in a leaf shape, and a wide mouth of white and red zigzag.
works.caption: A mask in a white frame, a red target eye in a box, a gold leaf-shaped eye, zigzag teeth.
works.reading: The target eye is red and gold rings in a box at the upper right. The leaf-shaped eye at the left has a spiral inside. The mouth is a long box with white bars and red zigzag. Recorded with 223 strokes.

chapters.title: Masks and Skulls
chapters.opening: October 30 to November 9, 2022. Ten masks: a crowned face with a red X eye, a green skull, two pink faces with one eye each, a half-sun skull, a skull in red rays, and three on pink.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #4
works.text: A mask with a crown of red spikes, a red X over one eye and a cross over the other, a snarl of white teeth, on stripes of yellow and teal.
works.caption: A mask crowned with red spikes, a red X over one eye, a cross over the other, white teeth.
works.reading: The crown is a row of red triangles on a yellow band. The X eye is red over a yellow box; the cross eye is red bars over a white box. The teeth are white blocks in a red mouth. The stripes at the right are teal and white bars. Recorded with 175 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #5
works.text: A round green skull with two ringed eyes, one red and one blue, a crown of purple capsules, and a wide grin of white teeth, drawn over olive.
works.caption: A round green skull with a red ringed eye and a blue one, purple capsules on top, a grin.
works.reading: The capsules are purple ovals in a row along the top. The eyes are large rings with spiky lashes, red on the left and blue on the right. The teeth are white blocks in a dark mouth. Recorded with 153 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #19
works.text: A face in profile on pink with one huge eye ringed in yellow and pink lashes, a red pupil, blue tubes hanging under it, and a small red mouth. The face is painted in dark red and drawn over in white and pink. A black shadow lies along the bottom. It is the first of a pair: the same face returns an hour later with blue hair.
works.caption: A face in profile on pink with one huge yellow-ringed eye, blue tubes hanging beneath it.
works.reading: The eye is a white oval with a red pupil, ringed in yellow and fringed with pink lashes. The tubes are blue capsules under the eye like tears. The mouth at the lower left is a red mark with a white tooth. Recorded with 117 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #20
works.text: The same face an hour later, now with a crest of blue hair, a yellow flower in its mouth, and a yellow coat, on the same pink.
works.caption: A face in profile on pink with a huge ringed eye, blue hair, a yellow flower in its mouth.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of blue and purple scribble along the top of the head. The flower hangs from the mouth on a green stem. The coat at the lower right is yellow with dark folds. Recorded with 277 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #24
works.text: A skull split down the middle: the left half painted in soft yellow with a pale eye, the right half a gold sun-face with a spiral eye and a ring of yellow rays. A rope of gold runs down between them. The mouth is a grille of white teeth in a gold box. The ground is a haze of orange and purple discs. Two faces in one skull, one quiet and one burning.
works.caption: A skull split in two, the left half soft yellow with a pale eye, the right a gold sun-face.
works.reading: The sun-face at the right is a gold disc with a spiral eye, a small mouth and a ring of yellow rays. The rope between the halves is drawn as a chain of gold loops. The teeth are white blocks with grey shadow. Recorded with 333 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #25
works.text: A skull mask in a field of red rays, drawn in white and blue line with a target eye crossed in red at the left and a spiral eye at the right, a grille of white teeth, and a crown of spikes. Bones cross below the jaw. The rays are short red strokes on dark grey, standing out from the skull on every side. With 576 recorded strokes it is the most worked mask in the room.
works.caption: A skull mask in a field of red rays, a crossed target eye, a spiral eye, white teeth, bones below.
works.reading: The rays are drawn in red and orange at even spacing around the whole square. The eyes sit in white boxes with spiky lashes. The bones at the bottom are two white shapes crossed. The crown is white and blue spikes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #29
works.text: A patterned mask on pink, drawn in loose loops of white, green, blue and yellow, with two ringed eyes and a mouth of white bars.
works.caption: A patterned mask on pink in loose loops of white, green and blue, two ringed eyes, white bars.
works.reading: The loops run over the whole face and out past its edge. The eyes are two rings with red centers. The mouth is a box of white bars. Sixty-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #30
works.text: A mask on pink with a red crown on a yellow head, a red spiral eye, a wheel eye, a rainbow mouth, and a ring of beads around the face.
works.caption: A mask on pink with a red crown, a spiral eye, a wheel eye, a rainbow mouth, beads around.
works.reading: The crown is red with three points on a yellow box. The rainbow mouth is bands of green, purple and orange falling from a red zigzag. The beads are yellow and green circles. Recorded with 233 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #31
works.text: A round mask with a crest of orange spikes and a spiral eye stands on a stick body with two blue arms, on brown.
works.caption: A round mask with a crest of orange spikes stands on a stick body with blue arms, on brown.
works.reading: The mask is a white ring filled with orange, green and blue pattern. The arms are two blue bars with white zigzag. The legs are thin lines with small boxes for feet. Recorded with 195 strokes.

chapters.title: Black Figures
chapters.opening: November 10 and 11, 2022. A dark scribbled head, then nine flat black figures in two days: a girl, a creature in a maze, a tube figure, a ghost in a frame, a man in the rain.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #32
works.text: A dark head on navy with cat ears, two red-rimmed eyes and a mouth of white teeth, drawn in colored scribble over black.
works.caption: A dark head on navy with cat ears, red-rimmed eyes and a mouth of white teeth, in scribble.
works.reading: The ears are two black points. The eyes are hollow with red around them. The teeth are a row of white blocks with black between. Recorded with 144 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #33
works.text: A black figure with spiky hair and yellow legs bends over in a tangle of yellow, white and pink pipes on pink.
works.caption: A black figure with spiky hair and yellow legs bends over in a tangle of pipes on pink.
works.reading: The pipes are thick strokes of yellow, white and lilac that turn at right angles. The figure's head has a small face in yellow line. The legs are yellow with teal shoes. Recorded with 112 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #34
works.text: A black figure on all fours in a maze of yellow pipes on green, its spiky head a ball with a red X eye and a grin, and three small black figures standing on its back. The big figure is one flat black shape with round feet. The maze is drawn in thick yellow strokes that fill every gap. It is the first of the flat black figures, and the small ones on its back are drawn the same way at a tenth of the size.
works.caption: A black figure on all fours in a maze of yellow pipes, three small black figures on its back.
works.reading: The small figures have round heads with spiky hair and X marks for eyes. The big figure's head has a red X and a red mouth. The maze is yellow over a darker yellow shadow. Recorded with 178 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #35
works.caption: A black tube figure with spiky hair and a red X face bends in a maze of blue pipes.
works.reading: The body is one thick black line bent at the knees and elbows, with round feet. The head is a ball with spikes and a red X and dash for a face. The maze is pale blue strokes over orange. Recorded with 114 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #36
works.text: A girl in a black dress with a white face and a ponytail stands in a teal frame, her hands white, a small red flower at her feet. The face is a white circle with two black eyes and an O mouth. The dress has a row of white buttons. Fifty-four strokes. A grey shadow falls behind her. It is the quietest figure in the room, and the only one with a flower.
works.caption: A girl in a black dress with a white face and a ponytail stands in a teal frame.
works.reading: The ponytail is drawn in black strokes tied with a red band. The hands are two white shapes at the ends of the sleeves. The shadow is a grey shape of fingers behind her. The frame is grey around teal.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #37
works.text: A black creature with yellow bands on its arms raises both hands in a teal frame, two white eyes with blue pupils, a grin, and a small black figure standing on its head.
works.caption: A black creature with yellow bands on its arms raises both hands, a small figure standing on its head.
works.reading: The small figure on top has its arms up and X eyes. The creature's eyes are white rings with blue centers. The grin is a row of small white teeth. The frame is grey around teal. Recorded with 119 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #38
works.caption: A face on red in loose black, blue and yellow line, a yellow X eye, a striped mouth.
works.reading: The lines are long and loose, and the face is found in them: an X in a ring at the right, a mouth of white and red bars below. Small patches of blue, tan and lilac sit at the edges. Seventy-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #39
works.text: A black head in profile with spiky hair on olive, one white eye, and a white hand raised to its chin, inside a dark frame. Twenty-five strokes. The head is one black shape with a long shadow behind it, and the hand is white so it shows. It is the sparest work in the series.
works.caption: A black head in profile with spiky hair on olive, one white eye, a white hand at its chin.
works.reading: The spikes are short black lines standing up from the forehead. The eye is a white dot with a white curve for a brow. The hand is a white shape with fingers folded. The shadow is a darker olive behind the head.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #40
works.text: A patterned mask on pink with goggles, two ringed eyes inside them, a crown of white spikes, and a mouth of white teeth, drawn in yellow and black line.
works.caption: A patterned mask on pink with goggles, two ringed eyes inside, a crown of white spikes, white teeth.
works.reading: The goggles are two boxes with yellow rings inside, joined at the bridge. The teeth are a long bar of white blocks in a red box. Yellow bars striped with black run down the sides. Recorded with 245 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz rawblocks #41
works.text: A black figure with a smiling X-eyed face and a red heart on its chest stands in blue rain under a yellow sun with a face, its arms out, two black hands rising at the bottom corners. Question marks float in clouds at the sides. It is drawn inside a cream frame. Where the girl in the teal frame stood still, this figure stands in weather, and the sun looks down at it with its own face.
works.caption: A black X-eyed figure with a red heart on its chest stands in blue rain under a smiling sun.
works.reading: The rain is blue dashes over a grey ground. The sun is a yellow disc with two eyes and a mouth, and its rays are yellow strokes. The question marks are drawn in black in white cloud shapes. The arms are yellow and black bands. Recorded with 266 strokes.

closing: Look again at the first mask, packed to its frame with beads and bars, and then at the black head in profile with its white hand, drawn in twenty-five strokes. Six months apart, and the whole range of the series is between them: everything, and almost nothing.
